video_title: Darius Acuff Jr. Opens Up on Losing in Sacramento, NBA Life & Allen Iverson

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on adjusting to the NBA and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: Losing is the worst thing to do in basketball, man. Nobody wants to lose, especially if you're a competitor.
quotes.quote: I'm good. Can't complain right now. Living the dream, here with the fam. Just enjoying Cali, enjoying the weather. Playing in the NBA, it's a dream come true. When you get to do that, you can't really complain about too much. You made it for once. Losing is the worst thing to do in basketball, man. Nobody wants to lose, especially if you're a competitor. For me, everywhere I've been, I was a winner. Never really cared about the stats, just winning was always my goal. It's definitely one of the toughest things I had to deal with for sure. In the NBA you just got to stick with it day by day, because it's 82 games. It's only been a month into the season, we still got way more time to connect and try to regroup and get more wins.
quotes.social_post: Darius Acuff Jr on the rookie grind: Losing is the worst thing to do in basketball. Nobody wants to lose, especially if you are a competitor.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the difficulty of guarding Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.excerpt: You kept the coaches up at night. They were stressed. Tommy Lloyd, all those guys.
quotes.quote: I'm not going to lie, Arizona Wildcat Richard Jefferson here, we were extremely nervous. You were the one player, obviously, we knew Michigan was a load, but we hadn't been to a Final Four and we knew we had to go through you. Such respect, been watching your game since last year is when I was first introduced to you. But everyone at Arizona spoke so highly of you. Like the coaches, you kept the coaches up at night. They were stressed. Tommy Lloyd, all those guys, they were very, very respectful of your game. I did the draft, so it was just, he was one of the players, he was like, 'Yo, that kid kept me up at night trying to figure out a game plan to slow him down.'
quotes.social_post: Richard Jefferson on scouting Darius Acuff Jr: Tommy Lloyd and the Arizona staff were stressed. That kid kept me up at night trying to figure out a game plan to slow him down.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on learning from veteran teammates and coaching
quotes.excerpt: The best part about being here is learning from the older guys.
quotes.quote: The best part about being here is learning from the older guys. I got great vets on my team who's had success personally and with the team. And my coaching staff is legendary. We got a couple guys who did some stuff in the NBA. I wouldn't necessarily say nobody for real, I'd say certain teams to play against like the Spurs. It's been good. I think we played them three times already, once in preseason, twice in the season. But just going against, I don't know man, everybody. Every night I get the 6'7, 6'8 guys, so every night it's somebody new. I can name a few, but definitely a lot of respect around the league. I just go out there and try to play with heart and just try to win.
quotes.social_post: Darius Acuff Jr on the NBA level: Every night I get the 6 foot 7, 6 foot 8 guys, so every night it is somebody new. I just go out there and try to play with heart.

quotes.speaker: Allie Clifton
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on his mindset during a tough season
quotes.excerpt: I'm not a loser. I don't know what to do, man.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: At 1 and 10 on the season, you were quoted recently saying, 'I'm not a loser. I don't know what to do, man.' Where during this stretch, as you try to be that guy for this franchise at this point of your career so young, who were you turning to for guidance during this stretch? Who were you leaning on?

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
text_blocks.text: God. You just got to, in times like this, your team, you got to have that camaraderie and that communication, because if that goes away, then it's going to get worse. Like nothing's going to get better. I think those are the guys that everybody's looking to, because we're the ones who are going through the stuff together. So we got to go through this together so we can go back up to the top.

quotes.social_post: Darius Acuff Jr on navigating a 1 and 10 start: You have to have that camaraderie and that communication, because if that goes away, then it is going to get worse.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on how Coach Matt changed his game
quotes.excerpt: Coach Matt, man. He changed my whole mindset about the game.
quotes.quote: Coach Matt, man. He changed my whole mindset about the game. He put me in the right position to change my body and my mental, not only on the court but off the court too. It made me grow up a little more. I went there as a 16-year-old. Just growing up a little bit, making that change, and I think that was a step towards that, and it prepared me to go to Arkansas and play for Coach Cal. It wasn't easy, but it wasn't so much hard because I was used to having a great coach and a guy who's going to get on you every day and just expect so much highly of you. As a player, as a player competitor I am, you want a coach like that who wants you to succeed, but ain't going to sugarcoat nothing with you.
quotes.social_post: Darius Acuff Jr on his development: Coach Matt changed my whole mindset about the game. He put me in the right position to change my body and my mental, not only on the court but off the court too.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on the grind of NBA travel
quotes.excerpt: It's like you on a plane every day. It's like, damn, can we, you know, can we go?
quotes.quote: It's crazy, you don't even know where you at. A couple times I forgot who we played. It's crazy, I did it all. Take a picture, bro. Take a picture of the room. It's crazy you said that. But, no, just traveling, bro. Just being on a plane. It's like you on a plane every day. It's like, damn, can we, you know, can we go? Like right now, we in the, we getting safe right now. We at a home stretch, so it's good for everybody. We love being at home. But in them first couple games we were on the road for a little bit, it felt like we was on a plane every day. So I definitely say that's the toughest part. But for me, I like it because I'm a hooper, so to play every other day to knowing that you wake up and you got a game tomorrow, that's the best part to me.
quotes.social_post: Darius Acuff Jr on the NBA lifestyle: It is crazy, you do not even know where you at. A couple times I forgot who we played. It is like you on a plane every day.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on his relationship with Allen Iverson
quotes.excerpt: I met AI for the first time in my senior year high school playing at the Iverson Classic.
quotes.quote: I met AI for the first time in my senior year high school playing at the Iverson Classic. I had just signed with Reebok. And it's crazy, we, you know, they had a little one-on-one, a little stuff up there, and he just showed up in the middle of it. And I'm like, oh, I'm like, there go AI. I'm like, yeah, I'm going to win. So, yeah, we got the win, winning the tournament, and then that was the first time he stood up. I shook his hand and it was, I told him he was my favorite player. And, you know, ever since then it's been a great connection. The number one thing he installed in me, he said, you know, just always be a dog first. Like, don't worry about nothing, be a dog first, go out there and play hard, and everything else will come later. And it makes sense, coming from a guy like him, because he went out there and he hustled, no matter what. He was a hustler on the court, and he's going to get to it regardless, he's going to die for it. And that's what he was giving advice to me, and I appreciated that. And ever since then it's been a great relationship, and, you know, that's my dog.
quotes.social_post: Darius Acuff Jr on advice from Allen Iverson: The number one thing he installed in me, he said, you know, just always be a dog first. Don't worry about nothing, be a dog first, go out there and play hard.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on how his Detroit roots influence his game
quotes.excerpt: I say getting downhill, just toughness. I would say Detroit, we built on that for sure.
quotes.quote: I say getting downhill, just toughness. I would say Detroit, we built on that for sure. So I say attacking downhill, not being, you know, not being fearless, you know, not being, not being afraid of nobody. No matter who down there, just going down there, testing somebody. Whoever you playing against every night, don't be fearless. And yeah, also just, you know, being a leader, I would say, coming from where I come from. You know, that's how we rated, we taught to be, you know, be leaders and lead by example. So I say those two things for sure.
quotes.social_post: Darius Acuff Jr on his Detroit roots: I say getting downhill, just toughness. I would say Detroit, we built on that for sure. Attacking downhill, not being afraid of nobody.
